svg.title: AnxioSense Architecture Diagram
svg.desc: Multi-agent retrieval-assisted anxiety screening pipeline showing user input, parallel agents, claims building, vector retrieval, evidence validation, and report generation.
svg.text: Multi-Agent LLM System with Retrieval-Assisted Evidence Validation
Formatted block saved to session store → injected post-LLM
2. PARALLEL EXTRACTION AGENTS · Mastra .parallel() · Mistral 7B · temp = 0.1 · CoT + one-shot prompting
Parses agent JSON outputs → normalises into typed claim objects with sourceAgent tag
Assigns sessionId · writes to in-memory session store
Checks factual consistency · removes unsupported claims · validates referral enum
Invalid risk_level (e.g. "elevated") → warns + defaults to "moderate" (conservative fallback)
Mistral never sees § 0 → cannot condense or drop it
Privacy: 100% local · Ollama + Mistral 7B · No external API calls · No PII leaves the device
